newsitem.title: CROATIA: Indonesians look for business ties with Croatia.
newsitem.headline: Indonesians look for business ties with Croatia.

text.p: Indonesian Research and Technology Minister Jusuf Habibie is visiting Croatia to talk to business leaders and government ministers about cooperation between the two economies, an official on the visit said.
Habibie will hold talks about "technological cooperation and the transfer of technology by both sides," an official from the Indonesian embassy in Budapest told Reuters.
Indonesia does not have an embassy in Zagreb.

Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa told Croatian television "our economies are structured in such a complementary manner that Indonesia is interested in the fields in which Croatia is successful and we are interested in those where Indonesia is good."
Using Croatian sea ports as an entry point into European markets was a possible area for business cooperation, the television report said.
